extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism adjudication from XML/PDF sections and figures; direct mechanism overclaiming is avoided.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD spectra support alpha-helical conformation for purified synthetic PTa and PHa in 50% TFE/NH4Ac membrane-mimic conditions; this is structural context, not a direct killing-mechanism assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct pore/permeabilization assay was performed for the antimicrobial mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper discusses toroidal-pore-like membrane disruption as an inferred model for antimicrobial activity based on peptide charge/hydrophobicity and helicity, while acknowledging that anti-biofilm mechanisms were not experimentally investigated.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Model is discussion-level inference and must not be promoted to direct mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SEM images and MBEC assays show phenotypic eradication/disruption of formed S. aureus biofilms at MBEC and 2x MBEC concentrations, but do not resolve the molecular anti-biofilm mechanism.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Phylloseptin-PTa and Phylloseptin-PHa against S. aureus biofilm
direct_assay_types: scanning electron microscopy of treated biofilms
mechanism_claims.limitations: Phenotypic biofilm eradication evidence is activity evidence; molecular mechanism remains unresolved.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The anticancer membrane-disruption explanation is inferential discussion associated with H157 cytostatic activity; source-supported quantitative output is IC50, not a direct cancer-cell mechanism assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: MTT supports cytostatic activity only; exact cell-lysis mechanism is not directly assayed.
